items.title: Akamai Technologies (AKAM) Forms Cyber Resilience Alliance In North America
items.summary: Akamai Technologies (NasdaqGS:AKAM) announced a new alliance with Deloitte Canada to support proactive cyber resilience for organizations across North America. The collaboration combines Akamai security products with Deloitte cybersecurity advisory and managed services for enterprise clients. Deloitte, recently recognized as Akamai's North America Services Provider of the Year, plans to use Akamai technology to help simplify client cyber architectures.
